newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices slightly down in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices slightly down in quiet trade.

text.p: Istanbul gold prices dropped on Wednesday in moribund trade, dealers said.
Gold lost 150 lira to end at 1,080,850 lira per gram, and dropped by $0.35 to $389.35 per ounce. Volume dropped by 58 percent to 735 kg.
Dealers said prices dropped on the Istanbul Gold Exchange due to easier gold prices in London and a weaker lira against the dollar in the domestic market.
The Turkish lira closed at 86,210 per dollar, down from Tuesday's 86,165 on a firmer dollar/mark parity.
There was 480 kg of trade in the morning and 255 kg in the afternoon. Of the total trade, 66 percent was in dollar terms and the rest in lira terms.
